subject: Helios Health — 90-day onramp, roles, timelines and escalation path
messages:
From: Karithik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@helioshealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Helios Health — 90-day onramp, roles, timelines and escalation path

Hi Sofia / Raj —

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier this week. Attached is a first-draft mutual action plan (Helios_MAP_v1.xlsx) that breaks the 90-day onramp into four milestone phases and assigns owners for each task. High-level asks in this email:

- Can you confirm the internal Helios stakeholders (technical lead + procurement contact) and any blackout dates in July/Aug we should avoid for cutovers?
- Please confirm your preferred weekly sync cadence (we usually do a 30-min ops call).
- Procurement: is there an expected PO date or contract review window we should plan for?

Summary of the MAP (high-level):
1) Phase 0 — Prework (Week 0–2) — NDA/Compliance signoff, access provisioning, security questionnaire (owner: Helios / Raj)
2) Phase 1 — Integration & Networking (Week 2–4) — VPC peering, auth, test harness (owner: Redwood / Monica)
3) Phase 2 — Pilot & Validation (Week 4–8) — Sample workloads, latency/cost targets, quality checks (owner: Redwood / Ben)
4) Phase 3 — Ramp & Cutover (Week 8–12) — Production traffic slice, rollback plan, handoff to CS (owner: Lauren)

Escalation path (proposed):
- Day-to-day: Monica / Ben
- SRE or platform issue: Karithik
- Contract/SLA exceptions: Lauren

Please take a look at the attached spreadsheet (column notes have more detail on acceptance criteria and dates). If this looks good I’ll publish an updated MAP and book the recurring sync for Mondays at 10:00 AM PT starting Monday 7/14.

Thanks,

--
Karithik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karithik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Attachments: Helios_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@helioshealth.com>

Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@helioshealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Helios Health — 90-day onramp, roles, timelines and escalation path

Thanks Karithik — this is extremely helpful. A few notes from our side: 

- Confirmed stakeholders: myself (SRE/product), Raj (technical lead) and procurement@helioshealth.com.
- Security questionnaire: we’ll have the first pass back by 2025-07-10. Raj will own any technical edits.
- Procurement window: procurement expects to review the contract and issue a PO by 2025-07-24, assuming no major redlines.

One ask on our end: for the pilot, can we include a short SLA for latency percentiles (p95) in test runs so our architecture team can validate end-to-end? Also, please include a named point of contact for 24/7 escalation (even if it’s an on-call rotation).

Can you confirm whether Redwood will provide a shared test dataset or should we share a sanitized sample?

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Director of Product Engineering | Helios Health
sofia.ramos@helioshealth.com

Onboarding team — quick update after reviewing Karithik’s draft and Sofia’s notes. I’ve sketched an implementation roster (attached) and adjusted milestone dates to reflect Helios’ procurement timeline (PO target 7/24). Key changes: 

- Phase 0 (Prework): move completion date to 2025-07-14 to allow for questionnaire turnaround (owner: Raj / Helios).
- Phase 1 (Integration): start 2025-07-15, complete by 2025-07-31 (owner: Monica).
- Pilot start: 2025-08-04, 2-week pilot window with p95 latency checks (owner: Ben).
- Ramp & Cutover: target 2025-08-25 for production slice, full cutover by 2025-09-05 with rollback window through 2025-09-12 (owner: Lauren).

I propose the weekly sync: Mondays at 10:00 AM PT starting 2025-07-14 (30 minutes). If that works for Helios, I’ll send the calendar invite.

Attachments: Implementation_Roster_v1.pdf — includes: owners, escalation contacts, required access lists, and acceptance criteria per milestone.

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Confirming next steps: 

1) Lauren will send the weekly sync invite for Mondays 10:00 AM PT starting 2025-07-14.
2) Helios to return the security questionnaire by 2025-07-10 (Raj).
3) Procurement to aim for PO by 2025-07-24. Procurement contact — please reply with any required contract language ASAP so we can minimize redlines.
4) Redwood team will publish the updated MAP (v1.1) to the shared Drive folder and flag acceptance criteria per milestone. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFg-helio-onramp
5) Pilot p95 latency target: we’ll run two scripted test windows during the pilot and capture metrics; Ben will share the test plan by 2025-07-18.

If there are no objections I’ll mark the MAP as agreed in HubSpot (HS-987654) and begin the prework checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Helios into pilot.
